# Native caller WF-support isolation

This deliberate omission diagnostic distinguishes caller WF command emission
from local proof placement/lowering/publication. It traverses the complete
original WF path and consumes the same expression/fuel state, then omits only
an accepted pure fragment for the selected caller. Reject unsupported fragments,
havoc and non-private assignments. Keep leading can-call support and every
actual check. Require exact assertion/fuel/attribute fingerprints, native controls
and genuine Invalid negative controls. No normal workflow enables this selector.
An improvement after removing support is causal evidence, never a product fix;
the intended product must retain assertion-equivalent proving support.
